calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (F k + F (q - 1 - k)) + (if q % 2 = 1 then F K else 0)
      ≤ 2 * A + C * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 K, (g k + g (k + 1)) + g K) := by
        rw [hpeel]
        have := Finset.sum_le_sum hpair
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at this
        nlinarith [hFA 0, hFA (q - 1)]

proof_context.conclusion: `F 0 + F (q-1) ≤ 2A` and the remaining residues `1 ≤ R ≤ q-2` are bounded by `C f_q(R+τ_R)` via `hFC` (hypothesis, line 554).

have hFC : ∀ R : ℕ, 1 ≤ R → R + 2 ≤ q →
      minA A C (Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) ^ 2) ≤ C * fq q (R + τ R) := by
    intro R h1 h2
    have hR1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have hR2 : (R : ℝ) + 2 ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast h2
    obtain ⟨t1, t2⟩ := hτ R
    have hpos : 0 < Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) := by
      apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
      · apply div_pos (mul_pos Real.pi_pos (by linarith)) hq0
      · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hq0]; nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    unfold minA
    rw [if_neg (by positivity)]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (le_of_eq (by rw [fq, mul_one_div]))

proof_context.conclusion: Discharges `hFC`: for `1 ≤ R`, `R+2 ≤ q`, `minA A C (sin²) ≤ C·fq q (R+τ R)` since `sin > 0`.

proof.summary: The two extreme residues are bounded by A each in `core_bound₁'`, while `lemma_4_1_1'` supplies the C-over-sin-squared bound that handles all remaining residues.
